subject: general
question: Asia Development Bank has approved a $231 million loan in December 2020 to construct the Lower Kopili Hydroelectric Power (LKHEP) plant for which of the following states in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **$231 million loan **has been authorised by the **Asian Development Bank (ADB**) for the **construction **of the **Lower Kopili Hydroelectric Power (LKHEP) **project in **Central Assam, India**.
 
• This **loan is part of a $300 million Assam Power Sector Investment Program **that ADB authorised in 2014.
 
• It is the **third and largest tranche**.
 
• Up till this point, the **project has updated the 70 MW Lakwa **gas project and enhanced the state's distribution networks.
 
• This **project would generate renewable energy **and **contribute **to **reducing **the state of Assam's rising **electricity consumption**.
 
• Additionally, it will **assist state power firms **in decreasing their reliance on costly electricity produced from fossil fuels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asia Development Bank**:

 
 
• The Asian Development Bank is a **regional development bank**.
 
• It was **established **on **19 December 1966**.
 
• It's **headquartered **in the Ortigas Center located in the city of **Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines**.
 
• The bank also maintains **31 field offices **around the world to promote social and economic development in Asia.
